remarks: Looking for a home in the Cranbury neighborhood that's in pristine condition? A home that's move-in ready? You've found it! Lovingly updated over the last several years, this impeccable 5 bedroom, 3.5 bath home is a must-see! The list of renovations and improvements is extensive and includes: new central air conditioning system (4 zones), new flooring on the first floor, completely renovated kitchen, new first floor windows and new sliding doors to the outside, renovated fireplace, new lighting throughout the house, new primary bathroom and walk-in closet, renovated non-primary bathroom (2nd floor), turned unfinished basement into a wonderful living space including living room/bedroom/bathroom (perfect in-law suite), new porch in the back of the house, new large storage shed, installed fencing and privacy bushes, added in-ground sprinkler system. Be the beneficiary of a completely updated home. Just move in your furniture and you're done!
